entities.summary:
Google Docs Editors is a web-based productivity office suite offered by Google within its Google Drive service. The suite includes:Google Docs 
Google Sheets (spreadsheet)
Google Slides 
Google Drawings 
Google Forms 
Google Sites 
Google Keep 
Google Vids 
Google My Maps
